paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) for several configurations of quantized pruning/kv-cache settings, shown as multiple lines across five layer ranges, with a dashed baseline reference. The x-axis is categorical with tick labels "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32" (no numeric units), evenly spaced. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from about −25% to +5%, with major tick labels at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%. A gray dashed horizontal baseline labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" lies at 0% across all layer groups. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, sitting near 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dipping to about −1.5% at Layer13-20, returning to about 0% at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% (around +0.3%) at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" series is a light-blue solid line with circular markers, starting around −1.5% at Layer1-4, around −2% at Layer5-12, reaching its lowest point near −13% at Layer13-20, then moving to about −2.5% at Layer21-28 and about −1.2% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" series is a red solid line with square markers, beginning near 0% at Layer1-4, decreasing to about −1% at Layer5-12, dropping further to about −4.5% at Layer13-20, rising to about −1.5% at Layer21-28, and ending close to 0% (around −0.3%) at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" series is a dark-blue solid line with square markers, starting around −3% at Layer1-4, around −4.5% at Layer5-12, reaching a minimum near −25% at Layer13-20, then increasing to about −5.5% at Layer21-28 and about −3.3% at Layer29-32.
